verdict.rationale: smolagents documents in-run agent memory: you can access it, replay it, change it via step callbacks, and run an agent step by step. Nothing in the pack shows long-term memory that is persisted to storage and restored across separate sessions or threads. In-run memory manipulation is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for cross-session persistence.

support.subject: As a developer, I can give agents long-term memory that persists across sessions and threads
